Only methods declared in candy-code-web/src, or inherited from a parent declared there, are listed. A type that extends a class outside that tree, such as \RuntimeException, does not show the methods of that class.

SugarCraft\CodeWeb

Assets final class

Locates the pre-built candy-code-web bundle on disk.

MethodSummary
static tryDistPath(): ?stringAbsolute path of the committed bundle (no trailing slash), or null when the install is incomplete.
static distPath(): stringAbsolute path of the committed bundle (no trailing slash).
static manifest(): arrayThe decoded Vite manifest: source entry => {file, css?, isEntry?, …}.
static version(): stringThe bundle's release version, as package.json declared it at build time.
static diagnose(string $packageRoot): arrayStructured health report for any package root — the whole failure surface of distPath(), manifest() and version() made observable without a thrown exception. Written for tests and a future serve doctor; the package's own root is just one argument.
